translation.en: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الشعراء 26:169

context.en: Asked for rescue from what his own town did, not from the town's punishment.
context.ar: دعا به بعد تكذيب قومه.

dhikrs.search: رب نجني واهلي مما يعملون my lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, support me against the corrupting people

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة العنكبوت 29:30

context.en: Said when the guests had come and the crowd was at his door.
context.ar: دعا به على القوم المفسدين.

dhikrs.search: رب انصرني علي القوم المفسدين my lord, support me against the corrupting people

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ

translation.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

transliteration.en: Allahumma a'innee 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḥusni 'ibadatik.

reference.en: Sunan Abi Dawud 1522 (no. 1523), narrated by Mu'adh ibn Jabal. Graded sahih by al-Albani.
reference.ar: سنن أبي داود (١٥٢٢)، عن معاذ بن جبل رضي الله عنه، وصححه الألباني.

context.en: He took Mu'adh by the hand and told him twice that he loved him, and then said: never leave off saying this at the end of every prayer.
context.ar: أخذ بيده وقال: يا معاذ، والله إني لأحبك، ثم أوصاه بهذا الدعاء دبر كل صلاة.

dhikrs.search: اللهم اعني علي ذكرك وشكرك وحسن عبادتك allahumma a'innee 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik. o allah, help me to remember you, to thank you, and to worship you well.

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَقِيرٞ

translation.en: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة القصص 28:24

context.en: Said in the shade in Madyan — a fugitive with nothing — and it is the whole of what he asked for.
context.ar: قاله في ظل الشجرة بمدين.

dhikrs.search: رب اني لما انزلت الي من خير فقير my lord, indeed i am, for whatever good you would send down to me, in need

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدۡخِلۡنَا فِي رَحۡمَتِكَۖ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الأعراف 7:151

context.en: Said after he had thrown down the tablets and seized his brother's head in anger, and then thought better of it.
context.ar: قاله بعد رجوعه من الميقات وغضبه على أخيه.

dhikrs.search: رب اغفر لي ولاخي وادخلنا في رحمتك وانت ارحم الرحمين my lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into your mercy, for you are the most merciful of the merciful

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] And ease for me my task And untie the knot from my tongue That they may understand my speech

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة طه 20:25-28

context.en: Said when he was told to go to Pharaoh. He asked for a wider chest and a clearer tongue, in that order.
context.ar: قاله حين أُمر بالذهاب إلى فرعون.

dhikrs.search: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي امري واحلل عقده من لساني يفقهوا قولي my lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي

translation.en: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me,

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة القصص 28:16

context.en: Said the moment he realised the man he struck was dead.
context.ar: قاله بعد أن وكز الرجل فقضى عليه.

dhikrs.search: رب اني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي my lord, indeed i have wronged myself, so forgive me,

dhikrs.arabic: رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِي مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقٖ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِي مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقٖ وَٱجۡعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَٰنٗا نَّصِيرٗا

translation.en: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الإسراء 17:80

context.en: For an honest entrance and an honest exit — said on leaving Makkah, and said on entering anywhere since.
context.ar: نزلت عند الخروج من مكة.

dhikrs.search: رب ادخلني مدخل صدق واخرجني مخرج صدق واجعل لي من لدنك سلطنا نصيرا my lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from yourself a supporting authority

dhikrs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة المؤمنون 23:118

context.en: The last ayah of Surat al-Mu'minun, and the words the surah chooses to end on.
context.ar: خاتمة سورة المؤمنون.

dhikrs.search: رب اغفر وارحم وانت خير الرحمين my lord, forgive and have mercy, and you are the best of the merciful

dhikrs.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة طه 20:114

context.en: The only thing in the Qur'an the Prophet ﷺ was commanded to ask for more of.
context.ar: الشيء الوحيد الذي أُمر النبي ﷺ أن يستزيد منه.

dhikrs.search: رب زدني علما my lord, increase me in knowledge

dhikrs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة نوح 71:28

context.en: His prayer for his parents, for himself, and for everyone who would ever enter his house believing.
context.ar: دعاؤه لوالديه ولمن دخل بيته مؤمنًا.

dhikrs.search: رب اغفر لي ولولدي ولمن دخل بيتي مومنا وللمومنين والمومنت ولا تزد الظلمين الا تبارا my lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. and do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction

dhikrs.arabic: أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ

translation.en: Indeed, I am overpowered, so help

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة القمر 54:10

context.en: Said when his people had finally worn him down — four words, and the flood came.
context.ar: دعا به بعد أن يئس من قومه.

dhikrs.search: اني مغلوب فانتصر indeed, i am overpowered, so help

dhikrs.arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلٗا مُّبَارَكٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us]

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة المؤمنون 23:29

context.en: Taught to him for the moment he came off the ark onto unfamiliar ground. Said today when arriving anywhere new.
context.ar: عُلِّمها عند نزوله من السفينة.

dhikrs.search: رب انزلني منزلا مباركا وانت خير المنزلين my lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and you are the best to accommodate [us]

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةٗ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ

translation.en: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة البقرة 2:201

context.en: The supplication the Prophet ﷺ made most often of any.
context.ar: أكثر ما كان يدعو به النبي ﷺ.

virtue.en: Anas ibn Malik said that the supplication the Prophet ﷺ made most often was this one.
virtue.ar: قال أنس: كان أكثر دعاء النبي ﷺ هذا.

dhikrs.search: ربنا ءاتنا في الدنيا حسنه وفي الاخره حسنه وقنا عذاب النار our lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the fire

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

translation.en: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة التحريم 66:8

context.en: Said on the day the light goes ahead of people and they ask for it to hold.
context.ar: دعاء المؤمنين يوم القيامة.

dhikrs.search: ربنا اتمم لنا نورنا واغفر لنا انك علي كل شيء قدير our lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. indeed, you are over all things competent

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الفرقان 25:74

context.en: The prayer of the servants of the Most Merciful, for their families.
context.ar: دعاء عباد الرحمن.

dhikrs.search: ربنا هب لنا من ازوجنا وذريتنا قره اعين واجعلنا للمتقين اماما our lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَلِإِخۡوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلّٗا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الحشر 59:10

context.en: A prayer for everyone who believed before you, and against carrying anything against them.
context.ar: دعاء من جاء بعد المهاجرين والأنصار.

dhikrs.search: ربنا اغفر لنا ولاخوننا الذين سبقونا بالايمن ولا تجعل في قلوبنا غلا للذين ءامنوا ربنا انك رءوف رحيم our lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. our lord, indeed you are kind and merciful

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلۡمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُسۡتَغۡفِرِينَ بِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ

translation.en: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allah], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة آل عمران 3:16-17

context.en: The prayer of those who ask forgiveness in the last part of the night.
context.ar: دعاء المستغفرين بالأسحار.

dhikrs.search: ربنا اننا ءامنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وقنا عذاب النار الصبرين والصدقين والقنتين والمنفقين والمستغفرين بالاسحار our lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the fire the patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of allah], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة البقرة 2:286

context.en: The end of al-Baqarah. It was said after each request: "I have done so."
context.ar: خاتمة سورة البقرة.

dhikrs.search: ربنا لا تواخذنا ان نسينا او اخطانا ربنا ولا تحمل علينا اصرا كما حملته علي الذين من قبلنا ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقه لنا به واعف عنا واغفر لنا وارحمنا انت مولينا فانصرنا علي القوم الكفرين our lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. our lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which you laid upon those before us. our lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. and pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. you are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوبَنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوۡمٖ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ

translation.en: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة آل عمران 3:8-9

context.en: A prayer against the heart moving after it has been shown where to stand.
context.ar: دعاء الراسخين في العلم.

dhikrs.search: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد اذ هديتنا وهب لنا من لدنك رحمه انك انت الوهاب ربنا انك جامع الناس ليوم لا ريب فيه ان الله لا يخلف الميعاد [who say], "our lord, let not our hearts deviate after you have guided us and grant us from yourself mercy. indeed, you are the bestower our lord, surely you will gather the people for a day about which there is no doubt. indeed, allah does not fail in his promise

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلٗا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدۡخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدۡ أَخۡزَيۡتَهُۥۖ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارٖ رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِيٗا يُنَادِي لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ أَنۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَـَٔامَنَّاۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخۡزِنَا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ

translation.en: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة آل عمران 3:191-194

context.en: Said by people who had been looking at the sky. The Prophet ﷺ recited these ayat on waking in the night.
context.ar: دعاء أولي الألباب، وكان النبي ﷺ يقرؤها إذا قام من الليل.

dhikrs.search: ربنا ما خلقت هذا بطلا سبحنك فقنا عذاب النار ربنا انك من تدخل النار فقد اخزيته وما للظلمين من انصار ربنا اننا سمعنا مناديا ينادي للايمن ان ءامنوا بربكم فامنا ربنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وكفر عنا سياتنا وتوفنا مع الابرار ربنا وءاتنا ما وعدتنا علي رسلك ولا تخزنا يوم القيمه انك لا تخلف الميعاد our lord, you did not create this aimlessly; exalted are you [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the fire our lord, indeed whoever you admit to the fire - you have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers our lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'believe in your lord,' and we have believed. our lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous our lord, and grant us what you promised us through your messengers and do not disgrace us on the day of resurrection. indeed, you do not fail in [your] promise

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِزَّ الإِسْلاَمَ بِأَحَبِّ هَذَيْنِ الرَّجُلَيْنِ إِلَيْكَ بِأَبِي جَهْلٍ أَوْ بِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ

translation.en: O Allah, strengthen Islam with whichever of these two men is more beloved to You — with Abu Jahl, or with 'Umar ibn al-Khattab.

reference.en: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3681 (no. 3774), narrated by Ibn 'Umar. Graded hasan sahih gharib by at-Tirmidhi.
reference.ar: سنن الترمذي، عن ابن عمر، قال الترمذي: حسن صحيح غريب.

context.en: Said when the Muslims in Makkah could be counted, and the two most formidable men in the city were both against them. One of the two became the second caliph.
context.ar: دعا به والمسلمون قلة بمكة.

dhikrs.search: اللهم اعز الاسلام باحب هذين الرجلين اليك بابي جهل او بعمر بن الخطاب o allah, strengthen islam with whichever of these two men is more beloved to you — with abu jahl, or with 'umar ibn al-khattab.

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِزْ لِي مَا وَعَدْتَنِي اللَّهُمَّ آتِ مَا وَعَدْتَنِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تَهْلِكْ هَذِهِ الْعِصَابَةُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الإِسْلاَمِ لاَ تُعْبَدْ فِي الأَرْضِ

translation.en: O Allah, fulfil for me what You promised me. O Allah, bring about what You promised me. O Allah, if this band of the people of Islam perishes, You will not be worshipped on the earth.

reference.en: Sahih Muslim 1763 (no. 4456), narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab.
reference.ar: صحيح مسلم (١٧٦٣)، عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه.

context.en: He faced the qiblah and stretched out his hands and called on his Lord until his cloak fell from his shoulders. Abu Bakr picked it up, put it back, and told him that was enough — his Lord would keep His promise.
context.ar: استقبل القبلة ومدَّ يديه، فما زال يهتف بربه حتى سقط رداؤه عن منكبيه.

dhikrs.search: اللهم انجز لي ما وعدتني اللهم ات ما وعدتني اللهم ان تهلك هذه العصابه من اهل الاسلام لا تعبد في الارض o allah, fulfil for me what you promised me. o allah, bring about what you promised me. o allah, if this band of the people of islam perishes, you will not be worshipped on the earth.

dhikrs.arabic: إِنَّ الْعَيْنَ تَدْمَعُ، وَالْقَلْبَ يَحْزَنُ، وَلاَ نَقُولُ إِلاَّ مَا يَرْضَى رَبُّنَا، وَإِنَّا بِفِرَاقِكَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَمَحْزُونُونَ

translation.en: The eye sheds tears and the heart grieves, and we say nothing but what pleases our Lord. And we are grieved by your parting, Ibrahim.

reference.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 1303 (no. 1261), narrated by Anas ibn Malik.
reference.ar: صحيح البخاري، عن أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه.

context.en: His infant son was dying in his arms and his eyes were overflowing. 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn 'Awf said, "Even you?" He said: "Ibn 'Awf, it is mercy" — and then said this.
context.ar: قاله وإبراهيم يجود بنفسه، وعيناه ﷺ تذرفان.

dhikrs.search: ان العين تدمع، والقلب يحزن، ولا نقول الا ما يرضي ربنا، وانا بفراقك يا ابراهيم لمحزونون the eye sheds tears and the heart grieves, and we say nothing but what pleases our lord. and we are grieved by your parting, ibrahim.

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِقَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translation.en: O Allah, forgive my people, for they do not know.

reference.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 3477 (Book 60, no. 3331). Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud.
reference.ar: صحيح البخاري، عن عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه.

context.en: The Prophet ﷺ describing a prophet before him — struck bloody by his own people, wiping the blood from his face, and asking forgiveness for them while he did it.
context.ar: قاله النبي ﷺ يحكي نبيًّا من الأنبياء ضربه قومه فأدموه.

note.en: Often quoted as the Prophet's own words at Ta'if. The soundest chain — this one — has him telling it of an earlier prophet. The narration at Ta'if is transmitted, but not with a chain of this strength.
note.ar: يُنسب كثيرًا إلى الطائف، وأصح ما ورد أنه حكاية عن نبي قبله.

dhikrs.search: اللهم اغفر لقومي فانهم لا يعلمون o allah, forgive my people, for they do not know.

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَفِي مُدِّنَا، وَصَحِّحْهَا لَنَا وَانْقُلْ حُمَّاهَا إِلَى الْجُحْفَةِ

translation.en: O Allah, make Madinah beloved to us as we love Makkah, or more. O Allah, bless us in our sa' and in our mudd, and make it healthy for us, and move its fever to al-Juhfah.

reference.ar: صحيح البخاري، عن عائشة رضي الله عنها.

context.en: Said when Abu Bakr and Bilal had both taken the fever of a city that was not theirs, and Bilal was reciting poetry about the valley he had left behind.
context.ar: قاله لما وُعك أبو بكر وبلال بالمدينة.

dhikrs.search: اللهم حبب الينا المدينه كحبنا مكه او اشد، اللهم بارك لنا في صاعنا، وفي مدنا، وصححها لنا وانقل حماها الي الجحفه o allah, make madinah beloved to us as we love makkah, or more. o allah, bless us in our sa' and in our mudd, and make it healthy for us, and move its fever to al-juhfah.

dhikrs.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ

translation.en: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

reference.en: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3522 (no. 3606), narrated by Umm Salamah. Graded hasan by at-Tirmidhi. Also narrated from Anas at no. 2208.
reference.ar: سنن الترمذي، عن أم سلمة، قال الترمذي: حسن.

context.en: Umm Salamah was asked what he said most often when he was with her. This was it — and when she asked why, he said that no one's heart is not between two of the fingers of the Most Merciful.
context.ar: سُئلت أم سلمة: ما كان أكثر دعاء رسول الله ﷺ إذا كان عندك؟ قالت: هذا.

dhikrs.search: يا مقلب القلوب ثبت قلبي علي دينك o turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon your religion.

dhikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰتِحِينَ

translation.en: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الأعراف 7:89

context.en: Asked God to judge between him and his people — which is what is left when argument has run out.
context.ar: دعا به بعد أن استنفد الحجة مع قومه.

dhikrs.search: ربنا افتح بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق وانت خير الفتحين our lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and you are the best of those who give decision

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة النمل 27:19

context.en: Said after he smiled at an ant. Given every power on earth, what he asked for was the ability to be grateful for it.
context.ar: قاله متبسمًا من قول النملة.

dhikrs.search: رب اوزعني ان اشكر نعمتك التي انعمت علي وعلي ولدي وان اعمل صلحا ترضيه وادخلني برحمتك في عبادك الصلحين my lord, enable me to be grateful for your favor which you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which you approve. and admit me by your mercy into [the ranks of] your righteous servants

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة ص 38:35

context.en: He asked for a kingdom no one after him would have — and asked for forgiveness first.
context.ar: سأل ربه ملكًا لا ينبغي لأحد من بعده.

dhikrs.search: رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لاحد من بعدي انك انت الوهاب my lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. indeed, you are the bestower

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّنَا فَتَسْقِينَا وَإِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِعَمِّ نَبِيِّنَا فَاسْقِنَا

translation.en: O Allah, we used to ask You by means of our Prophet and You would give us rain. And we ask You now by means of our Prophet's uncle — so give us rain.

reference.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 1010 (no. 982), narrated by Anas ibn Malik.
reference.ar: صحيح البخاري (١٠١٠)، عن أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه.

context.en: In a year of drought, 'Umar did not lead the prayer for rain himself. He put al-'Abbas — the Prophet's ﷺ uncle, an old man by then — in front of the people, and said this. Anas says they were given rain.
context.ar: كان عمر إذا قحطوا استسقى بالعباس بن عبد المطلب.

dhikrs.search: اللهم انا كنا نتوسل اليك بنبينا فتسقينا وانا نتوسل اليك بعم نبينا فاسقنا o allah, we used to ask you by means of our prophet and you would give us rain. and we ask you now by means of our prophet's uncle — so give us rain.

dhikrs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَشۡكُواْ بَثِّي وَحُزۡنِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

translation.en: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة يوسف 12:86

context.en: Said after decades of grief, to the sons who told him to stop grieving.
context.ar: قاله بعد فقد يوسف وأخيه.

dhikrs.search: انما اشكوا بثي وحزني الي الله واعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون i only complain of my suffering and my grief to allah, and i know from allah that which you do not know

dhikrs.arabic: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الأنبياء 21:87

context.en: Said inside the whale, inside the dark, inside the sea. The du'a of Dhun-Nun.
context.ar: دعوة ذي النون إذ نادى في الظلمات.

virtue.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "No Muslim supplicates with it for anything, ever, but Allah answers him."
virtue.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «لم يدعُ بها رجلٌ مسلمٌ في شيءٍ قط إلا استجاب الله له».

dhikrs.search: لا اله الا انت سبحنك اني كنت من الظلمين there is no deity except you; exalted are you. indeed, i have been of the wrongdoers

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسِّجۡنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِۖ وَإِلَّا تَصۡرِفۡ عَنِّي كَيۡدَهُنَّ أَصۡبُ إِلَيۡهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة يوسف 12:33

context.en: Said with the door locked behind him and the choice in front of him. He asked for prison.
context.ar: قاله حين رُوِدَ عن نفسه.

dhikrs.search: رب السجن احب الي مما يدعونني اليه والا تصرف عني كيدهن اصب اليهن واكن من الجهلين my lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. and if you do not avert from me their plan, i might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِي مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّۦ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة يوسف 12:101

context.en: Said at the height of everything he had been given — a throne, a reunited family — and what he asked for was to die a Muslim.
context.ar: قاله بعد أن جمع الله شمله بأهله.

dhikrs.search: رب قد ءاتيتني من الملك وعلمتني من تاويل الاحاديث فاطر السموت والارض انت ولي في الدنيا والاخره توفني مسلما والحقني بالصلحين my lord, you have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. creator of the heavens and earth, you are my protector in this world and in the hereafter. cause me to die a muslim and join me with the righteous

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةٗ طَيِّبَةًۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة آل عمران 3:38

context.en: Said the instant he saw the provision with Maryam — he did not wait, he asked there and then.
context.ar: دعا به حين رأى ما عند مريم من الرزق.

dhikrs.search: رب هب لي من لدنك ذريه طيبه انك سميع الدعاء my lord, grant me from yourself a good offspring. indeed, you are the hearer of supplication

dhikrs.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ

translation.en: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors

reference.ar: القرآن — سورة الأنبياء 21:89

context.en: The prayer of someone afraid of being the last of his line, who then said God is the best of inheritors anyway.
context.ar: دعا ربه ألا يذره فردًا.

dhikrs.search: رب لا تذرني فردا وانت خير الورثين my lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors

dhikrs.arabic: ( الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )

translation.en: (All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.)

transliteration.en: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار الاستيقاظ من النوم

dhikrs.search: ( الحمد لله الذي احيانا بعد ما اماتنا، واليه النشور ) (alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.) (all praise is for allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto him is the resurrection.)

dhikrs.arabic: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).

translation.en: In the name of Allah).  O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.)

transliteration.en: ((Bismil-lah) allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء دخول الخلاء

dhikrs.search: ([بسم الله] اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الخبث والخبايث). ((bismil-lah) allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.) in the name of allah).  o allah, i take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.)

dhikrs.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْـــــــــــدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.

translation.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

transliteration.en: Recite Ayat-Al-Kursiy (Al-Baqarah :255)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: ﴿الله لا اله الا هو الحي القيوم لا تاخذه سنه ولا نوم له ما في السموات وما في الارض من ذا الذي يشفع عنده الا باذنه يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون بشيء من علمه الا بما شاء وسع كرسيه السموات والارض ولا يووده حفظهما وهو العلي العظيم﴾. recite ayat-al-kursiy (al-baqarah :255) allah - there is no deity except him, the ever-living, the sustainer of [all] existence. neither drowsiness overtakes him nor sleep. to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. who is it that can intercede with him except by his permission? he knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of his knowledge except for what he wills. his kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires him not. and he is the most high, the most great.

dhikrs.arabic: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.

translation.en: ( 285 )   The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination.( 286 )   Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

transliteration.en: Recite last two verses of Soorah (Al-Baqarah :285-286)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: ﴿امن الرسول بما انزل اليه من ربه والمومنون كل امن بالله وملايكته وكتبه ورسله لا نفرق بين احد من رسله وقالوا سمعنا واطعنا غفرانك ربنا واليك المصير* لا يكلف الله نفسا الا وسعها لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت ربنا لا تواخذنا ان نسينا او اخطانا ربنا ولا تحمل علينا اصرا كما حملته علي الذين من قبلنا ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقه لنا به واعف عنا واغفر لنا وارحمنا انت مولانا فانصرنا علي القوم الكافرين﴾. recite last two verses of soorah (al-baqarah :285-286) ( 285 )   the messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his lord, and [so have] the believers. all of them have believed in allah and his angels and his books and his messengers, [saying], we make no distinction between any of his messengers. and they say, we hear and we obey. [we seek] your forgiveness, our lord, and to you is the [final] destination.( 286 )   allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. it will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. our lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. our lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which you laid upon those before us. our lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. and pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. you are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

dhikrs.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.

translation.en: (In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.)

transliteration.en: (Bismika rabbee wada'tu janbee wabika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfathha bima tahfathu bihi 'ibadakas-saliheen.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: باسمك ربي وضعت جنبي، وبك ارفعه، فان امسكت نفسي فارحمها، وان ارسلتها فاحفظها، بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين. (bismika rabbee wada'tu janbee wabika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfathha bima tahfathu bihi 'ibadakas-saliheen.) (in your name my lord, i lie down and in your name i rise, so if you should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if you should return my soul then protect it in the manner you do so with your righteous servants.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfathha, wa-in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma innee as-alukal-'afiyah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: اللهم انك خلقت نفسي وانت توفاها، لك مماتها ومحياها، ان احييتها فاحفظها، وان امتها فاغفر لها. اللهم اني اسالك العافيه. (allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfathha, wa-in amattaha faghfir laha. allahumma innee as-alukal-'afiyah.) (o allah, verily you have created my soul and you shall take it’s life, to you belongs it’s life and death. if you should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if you should take it’s life then forgive it. o allah, i ask you to grant me good health.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma qinee 'athabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك. (allahumma qinee 'athabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.) (o allah, protect me from your punishment on the day your servants are resurrected.)

dhikrs.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا.

translation.en: (In Your name O Allah, I live and die.)

transliteration.en: (Bismikal-lahumma amootu wa-ahya.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: باسمك اللهم اموت واحيا. (bismikal-lahumma amootu wa-ahya.) (in your name o allah, i live and die.)

dhikrs.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ).

translation.en: (How Perfect Allah is. (thirty-three times) All praise is for Allah.(thirty-three times) Allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times

transliteration.en: (Subhanal-lah. (thirty-three times) Alhamdu lillah. (thirty-three times) Allahu akbar. (thirty-four times))

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: سبحان الله (ثلاثا وثلاثين) والحمد لله (ثلاثا وثلاثين) والله اكبر (اربعا وثلاثين). (subhanal-lah. (thirty-three times) alhamdu lillah. (thirty-three times) allahu akbar. (thirty-four times)) (how perfect allah is. (thirty-three times) all praise is for allah.(thirty-three times) allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.

translation.en: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock (i.e. You have total mastery over). O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You.You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You.Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.)(Tawrah: The book revealed to Moosa u.)(Injeel: The book revealed to Easa u.)(Furqan: One of the many names of the Quran, means: The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(Aththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sab', warabbal-'arshil-'atheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, a'oothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa ba'daka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi 'annad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: اللهم رب السموات السبع ورب الارض، ورب العرش العظيم، ربنا ورب كل شيء، فالق الحب والنوي، ومنزل التوراه والانجيل، والفرقان، اعوذ بك من شر كل شيء انت اخذ بناصيته. اللهم انت الاول فليس قبلك شيء، وانت الاخر فليس بعدك شيء، وانت الظاهر فليس فوقك شيء، وانت الباطن فليس دونك شيء، اقض عنا الدين واغننا من الفقر. (allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sab', warabbal-'arshil-'atheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, a'oothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa ba'daka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi 'annad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr.) (o allah, lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our lord and lord of all things, splitter of the seed and the date stone, revealer of the tawrah, the injeel and the furqan, i take refuge in you from the evil of all things you shall seize by the forelock (i.e. you have total mastery over). o allah, you are the first so there is nothing before you and you are the last so there is nothing after you.you are aththahir so there is nothing above you and you are al-batin so there is nothing closer than you.settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.)(tawrah: the book revealed to moosa u.)(injeel: the book revealed to easa u.)(furqan: one of the many names of the quran, means: the criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(aththahir: indicates the greatness of his attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to his greatness and highness, for he is above all of his creation as regards his essence and attributes.)(al-batin: indicates his awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates his closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits his majesty.)

dhikrs.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ.

translation.en: (All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.)

transliteration.en: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee at'amana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wee.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: الحمد لله الذي اطعمنا وسقانا، وكفانا، واوانا، فكم ممن لا كافي له ولا مووي. (alhamdu lillahil-lathee at'amana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wee.) (all praise is for allah, who fed us and gave us drink, and who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.

translation.en: (O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You.  I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'oothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, wa-an aqtarifa 'ala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: اللهم عالم الغيب والشهاده فاطر السموات والارض، رب كل شيء ومليكه، اشهد ان لا اله الا انت، اعوذ بك من شر نفسي، ومن شر الشيطان وشركه، وان اقترف علي نفسي سوءا، او اجره الي مسلم. (allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'oothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, wa-an aqtarifa 'ala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.) (o allah, knower of the seen and the unseen, creator of the heavens and the earth, lord and sovereign of all things i bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except you.  i take refuge in you from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with allah in those things which are specific to him.  this can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than allah.)

dhikrs.arabic: (غُفْرَانَكَ).

translation.en: (I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.)

transliteration.en: (Ghufranak.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الخروج من الخلاء

dhikrs.search: (غفرانك). (ghufranak.) (i ask you (allah) for forgiveness.)

dhikrs.arabic: يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَة ِ،  وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ.

translation.en: (The Prophet  never used to sleep until he had recited Soorat As-Sajdah (chapter 32) and Soorat Al-Mulk (chapter 67).)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: يقرا ﴿الم﴾ تنزيل السجده ،  وتبارك الذي بيده الملك. (the prophet  never used to sleep until he had recited soorat as-sajdah (chapter 32) and soorat al-mulk (chapter 67).)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You.Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You.  I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.)(If you then die, you will die upon the fitrah.)(fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa-alja/tu thahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wala manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wabinabiyyikal-lathee arsalt.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار النوم

dhikrs.search: اللهم اسلمت نفسي اليك، وفوضت امري اليك، ووجهت وجهي اليك، والجات ظهري اليك، رغبه ورهبه اليك، لا ملجا ولا منجا منك الا اليك، امنت بكتابك الذي انزلت، وبنبيك الذي ارسلت. (allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa-alja/tu thahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wala manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wabinabiyyikal-lathee arsalt.) (o allah, i submit my soul unto you, and i entrust my affair unto you, and i turn my face towards you, and i totally rely on you, in hope and fear of you.verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from you except with you.  i believe in your book which you have revealed and in your prophet whom you have sent.)(if you then die, you will die upon the fitrah.)(fitrah: the religion of islam, the way of ibraheem u.)

dhikrs.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ.

translation.en: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar.Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.)(AL-Qahhar:The One Who has subdued all of creation and Whom all of creation are subservient to.  All movements occur by His will.)

transliteration.en: (La ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wama baynahuma, al'azeezul-ghaffar.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Turning over in the night
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء إذا تقلب ليلا

dhikrs.search: لا اله الا الله الواحد القهار، رب السموات والارض وما بينهما العزيز الغفار. (la ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wama baynahuma, al'azeezul-ghaffar.) (none has the right to be worshipped except allah, the one, al-qahhar.lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, the exalted in might, the oft-forgiving.)(al-qahhar:the one who has subdued all of creation and whom all of creation are subservient to.  all movements occur by his will.)

dhikrs.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ.

translation.en: (I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.)

transliteration.en: (a'oothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih,wa'iqabih, washarri 'ibadih, wamin hamazatish-shayateen, wa-an yahduroon.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Afraid or lonely at night
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الفزع في النوم و من بُلِيَ بالوحشة

dhikrs.search: اعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من غضبه وعقابه، وشر عباده، ومن همزات الشياطين وان يحضرون. (a'oothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih,wa'iqabih, washarri 'ibadih, wamin hamazatish-shayateen, wa-an yahduroon.) (i take refuge in the perfect words of allah from his anger and punishment, and from the evil of his servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.)

dhikrs.arabic: [ (يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ (ثلاثاً - (يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى (ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ - لاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا أَحَداً - يَــتَحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ ]

translation.en: [Spit on your left three times)(Spit: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle - (Seek refuge in Allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw (Three Times - (Do not relate it to anyone) - (Turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously.) - (Get up and pray if you so desire.) ]

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — After a bad dream
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يفعل من رأى الرؤيا أو الحلم

dhikrs.search: [ (ينفث عن يساره (ثلاثا - (يستعيذ بالله من الشيطان ومن شر ما راي (ثلاث مرات - لا يحدث بها احدا - يتحول عن جنبه الذي كان عليه ] [spit on your left three times)(spit: a form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle - (seek refuge in allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw (three times - (do not relate it to anyone) - (turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously.) - (get up and pray if you so desire.) ]

dhikrs.arabic: ويَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ.

translation.en: (Get up and pray if you so desire.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — After a bad dream
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يفعل من رأى الرؤيا أو الحلم

dhikrs.search: ويقوم يصلي ان اراد ذلك. (get up and pray if you so desire.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، [وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed.  Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You.For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.)(Evil you have decreed: Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way.Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. So evil exists in His creatures by His will and wisdom, not in His actions or act of creating.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt, wa'afinee feeman 'afayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabarik lee feema a'tayt, waqinee sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdee wala yuqda 'alayk, innahu la yathillu man walayt, [wala ya'izzu man 'adayt], tabarakta rabbana wata'alayt.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Qunut in the Witr
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء قنوت الوتر

dhikrs.search: اللهم اهدني فيمن هديت، وعافني فيمن عافيت، وتولني فيمن توليت، وبارك لي فيما اعطيت، وقني شر ما قضيت؛ فانك تقضي ولا يقضي عليك، انه لا يذل من واليت، [ولا يعز من عاديت]، تباركت ربنا وتعاليت. (allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt, wa'afinee feeman 'afayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabarik lee feema a'tayt, waqinee sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdee wala yuqda 'alayk, innahu la yathillu man walayt, [wala ya'izzu man 'adayt], tabarakta rabbana wata'alayt.) (o allah, guide me along with those whom you have guided, pardon me along with those whom you have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom you are an ally to and bless for me that which you have bestowed.  protect me from the evil you have decreed for verily you decree and none can decree over you.for surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom you take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. o our lord, blessed and exalted are you.)(evil you have decreed: allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does he punish anyone without having commited a sin. something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way.allah created the devil and by him, he tests his servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. so evil exists in his creatures by his will and wisdom, not in his actions or act of creating.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُــــوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innee a'oothu biridaka min sakhatik, wabimu'afatika min 'uqoobatik, wa-a'oothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an 'alayk, anta kama athnayta 'ala nafsik.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Qunut in the Witr
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء قنوت الوتر

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني اعوذ برضاك من سخطك، وبمعافاتك من عقوبتك، واعوذ بك منك، لا احصي ثناء عليك، انت كما اثنيت علي نفسك. (allahumma innee a'oothu biridaka min sakhatik, wabimu'afatika min 'uqoobatik, wa-a'oothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an 'alayk, anta kama athnayta 'ala nafsik.) (o allah, i take refuge within your pleasure from your displeasure and within your pardon from your punishment, and i take refuge in you from you. i cannot enumerate your praise. you are as you have praised yourself.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers.O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You.We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma iyyaka na'bud, walaka nusallee wanasjud, wa-ilayka nas'a wanahfid, narjoo rahmatak, wanakhsha 'athabak, inna 'athabaka bilkafireena mulhaq. Allahumma inna nasta'eenuk, wanastaghfiruk, wanuthnee 'alaykal- khayr, wala nakfuruk, wanu/minu bik, wanakhda'u lak wanakhla'u man yakfuruk.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Qunut in the Witr
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء قنوت الوتر

dhikrs.search: اللهم اياك نعبد، ولك نصلي ونسجد، واليك نسعي ونحفد، نرجو رحمتك، ونخشي عذابك، ان عذابك بالكافرين ملحق. اللهم انا نستعينك، ونستغفرك، ونثني عليك الخير، ولا نكفرك، ونومن بك، ونخضع لك، ونخلع من يكفرك. (allahumma iyyaka na'bud, walaka nusallee wanasjud, wa-ilayka nas'a wanahfid, narjoo rahmatak, wanakhsha 'athabak, inna 'athabaka bilkafireena mulhaq. allahumma inna nasta'eenuk, wanastaghfiruk, wanuthnee 'alaykal- khayr, wala nakfuruk, wanu/minu bik, wanakhda'u lak wanakhla'u man yakfuruk.) (o allah, it is you we worship, and unto you we pray and prostrate, and towards you we hasten and you we serve. we hope for your mercy and fear your punishment, verily your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers.o allah, we seek your aid and ask your pardon, we praise you with all good and do not disbelieve in you.we believe in you and submit unto you, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in you.)

dhikrs.arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ والثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بها ويَمُدُّ بها صَوتَهُ يقولُ: [رَبِّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ].

translation.en: (How perfect The King, The Holy One is.(three times) on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).

transliteration.en: (Subhanal-malikil-quddoos.(three times).on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh.))

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر عقب السلام من الوتر

dhikrs.search: سبحان الملك القدوس ثلاث مرات والثالثه يجهر بها ويمد بها صوته يقول: [رب الملايكه والروح]. (subhanal-malikil-quddoos.(three times).on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh.)) (how perfect the king, the holy one is.(three times) on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (lord of the angles and the rooh (i.e. jibra-eel).

dhikrs.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).

translation.en: (In the name of Allah.)

transliteration.en: (Bismil-lah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر قبل الوضوء

dhikrs.search: (بسم الله). (bismil-lah.) (in the name of allah.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي.

translation.en: (O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand (i.e. You have total mastery over), Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innee 'abduk, ibnu 'abdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, 'adlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw 'allamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indak, an taj'alal-Qurana rabee'a qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الهم والحزن

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني عبدك، ابن عبدك، ابن امتك، ناصيتي بيدك، ماض في حكمك، عدل في قضاوك، اسالك بكل اسم هو لك، سميت به نفسك، او انزلته في كتابك، او علمته احدا من خلقك، او استاثرت به في علم الغيب عندك، ان تجعل القران ربيع قلبي، ونور صدري، وجلاء حزني، وذهاب همي. (allahumma innee 'abduk, ibnu 'abdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, 'adlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw 'allamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indak, an taj'alal-qurana rabee'a qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee.) (o allah, i am your servant, son of your servant, son of your maidservant, my forelock is in your hand (i.e. you have total mastery over), your command over me is forever executed and your decree over me is just. i ask you by every name belonging to you which you named yourself with, or revealed in your book, or you taught to any of your creation, or you have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with you, that you make the quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.

translation.en: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, wal'ajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadal'id-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الهم والحزن

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الهم والحزن، والعجز والكسل، والبخل والجبن، وضلع الدين وغلبه الرجال. (allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, wal'ajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadal'id-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.) (o allah, i take refuge in you from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)

dhikrs.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.

translation.en: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.)

transliteration.en: (La ilaha illal-lahul-'atheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-'arshil-'atheem, la ilaha illal-lahu  rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-'arshil-kareem.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الكرب

dhikrs.search: لا اله الا الله العظيم الحليم، لا اله الا الله رب العرش العظيم، لا اله الا الله رب السموات ورب الارض ورب العرش الكريم. (la ilaha illal-lahul-'atheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-'arshil-'atheem, la ilaha illal-lahu  rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-'arshil-kareem.) (none has the right to be worshipped except allah forbearing.  none has the right to be worshipped except allah, lord of the magnificent throne.  none has the right to be worshipped except allah, lord of the heavens, lord of the earth and lord of the noble throne.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs.None has the right to be worshipped except You.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata 'ayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الكرب

dhikrs.search: اللهم رحمتك ارجو، فلا تكلني الي نفسي طرفه عين، واصلح لي شاني كله، لا اله الا انت. (allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata 'ayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant.) (o allah, it is your mercy that i hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs.none has the right to be worshipped except you.)

dhikrs.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ.

translation.en: (None has the right to be worshipped except You.  How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)

transliteration.en: (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الكرب

dhikrs.search: لا اله الا انت سبحانك اني كنت من الظالمين. (la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen.) (none has the right to be worshipped except you.  how perfect you are, verily i was among the wrong-doers.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً.

translation.en: (Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.)

transliteration.en: (None has the right to be worshipped except You.  How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الكرب

dhikrs.search: الله الله ربي لا اشرك به شييا. (none has the right to be worshipped except you.  how perfect you are, verily i was among the wrong-doers.) (allah, allah is my lord, i do not associate anything with him.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ.

translation.en: (O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma inna naj'aluka fee nuhoorihim wana'oothu bika min shuroorihim.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Facing an adversary or a ruler
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء لقاء العدو و ذي السلطان

dhikrs.search: اللهم انا نجعلك في نحورهم، ونعوذ بك من شرورهم. (allahumma inna naj'aluka fee nuhoorihim wana'oothu bika min shuroorihim.) (o allah, we place you before them and we take refuge in you from their evil.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ.

translation.en: (O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma anta 'adudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Facing an adversary or a ruler
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء لقاء العدو و ذي السلطان

dhikrs.search: اللهم انت عضدي، وانت نصيري، بك احول وبك اصول، وبك اقاتل. (allahumma anta 'adudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil) (o allah, you are my supporter and you are my helper, by you i move and by you i attack and by you i battle.)

dhikrs.arabic: حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ.

translation.en: (Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is).)

transliteration.en: (Hasbunal-lahu wani'mal-wakeel.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Facing an adversary or a ruler
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء لقاء العدو و ذي السلطان

dhikrs.search: حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل. (hasbunal-lahu wani'mal-wakeel.) (allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (he is).)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne,  be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.

transliteration.en: Allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Kun lee jaaran min (here you mention the person's name) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'Azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Against an unjust ruler
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من خاف ظلم السلطان

dhikrs.search: اللهم رب السموات السبع، ورب العرش العظيم، كن لي جارا من فلان بن فلان، واحزابه من خلايقك، ان يفرط علي احد منهم او يطغي، عز جارك، وجل ثناوك، ولا اله الا انت. allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa rabbal-'arshil-'adheem, kun lee jaaran min (here you mention the person's name) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'anta. o allah, lord of the seven heavens, lord of the magnificent throne,  be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. there is none worthy of worship but you.

dhikrs.arabic: (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ..).

translation.en: (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.)

transliteration.en: (Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu warasooluh.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر بعد الفراغ من الوضوء

dhikrs.search: (اشهد ان لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له واشهد ان محمدا عبده ورسوله..). (ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna muhammadan 'abduhu warasooluh.) (i bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except allah, alone without partner, and i bear witness that muhammad is his slave and messenger.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).

translation.en: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times in Arabic)

transliteration.en: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, Jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka.

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Against an unjust ruler
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من خاف ظلم السلطان

dhikrs.search: الله اكبر، الله اعز من خلقه جميعا، الله اعز مما اخاف واحذر، اعوذ بالله الذي لا اله الا هو، الممسك السموات السبع ان يقعن علي الارض الا باذنه، من شر عبدك فلان، وجنوده واتباعه واشياعه، من الجن والانس، اللهم كن لي جارا من شرهم، جل ثناوك وعز جارك، وتبارك اسمك، ولا اله غيرك (ثلاث مرات). allaahu akbar, allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka. allah is the most great, mightier than all his creation. he is mightier than what fear and dread. i seek refuge in allah, who there is none worthy of worship but him. he is the one who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by his command. [i seek refuge in you allah] from the evil of your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. o allah, be my support against their evil. glorious your praises and mighty is your patronage. blessed is your name, there is no true god but you. (recite three times in arabic)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ.

translation.en: (O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma munzilal-kitab, saree'al-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, allahummah-zimhum wazalzilhum.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء على العدو

dhikrs.search: اللهم منزل الكتاب، سريع الحساب، اهزم الاحزاب، اللهم اهزمهم وزلزلهم. (allahumma munzilal-kitab, saree'al-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, allahummah-zimhum wazalzilhum.) (o allah, revealer of the book, swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. o allah, defeat them and convulse them.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummak-fineehim bima shi/.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Fearing harm from people
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يقول من خاف قوما

dhikrs.search: اللهم اكفنيهم بما شيت. (allahummak-fineehim bima shi/.) (o allah, protect me from them with what you choose.)

dhikrs.arabic: يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ و يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ.

translation.en: (Say:) I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من أصابه وسوسة في الإيمان

dhikrs.search: يستعيذ بالله و ينتهي عما شك فيه. (say:) i seek refuge in allah. (then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)

dhikrs.arabic: يَقُولُ: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ.

translation.en: (He should say: (I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.

transliteration.en: (He should say: ( Amantu billahi warusulih.))

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من أصابه وسوسة في الإيمان

dhikrs.search: يقول: امنت بالله ورسله. (he should say: ( amantu billahi warusulih.)) (he should say: (i have believed in allah and his messenger.

dhikrs.arabic: يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾.

translation.en: (He should also recite the following verse: (He is The First and The Last, Aththahir and Al-Batin and He knows well all things.)(ththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.

transliteration.en: (He should also recite the following verse: ( Huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin 'aleem))

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من أصابه وسوسة في الإيمان

dhikrs.search: يقرا قوله تعالي: ﴿هو الاول والاخر والظاهر والباطن وهو بكل شيء عليم﴾. (he should also recite the following verse: ( huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin 'aleem)) (he should also recite the following verse: (he is the first and the last, aththahir and al-batin and he knows well all things.)(ththahir: indicates the greatness of his attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to his greatness and highness, for he is above all of his creation as regards his essence and attributes.)(al-batin: indicates his awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates his closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits his majesty.

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummak-finee bihalalika 'an haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika 'amman siwak.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء قضاء الدين

dhikrs.search: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك، واغنني بفضلك عمن سواك. (allahummak-finee bihalalika 'an haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika 'amman siwak.) (o allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by your grace, of need of others.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.

translation.en: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, wal'ajzi walkasal, walbukhl, waljubn, wadal'id-dayni waghalabatir-rijal)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء قضاء الدين

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني اعوذ بك من الهم والحزن، والعجز والكسل، والبخل والجبن، وضلع الدين وغلبه الرجال. (allahumma innee a'oothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, wal'ajzi walkasal, walbukhl, waljubn, wadal'id-dayni waghalabatir-rijal) (o allah, i take refuge in you from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)

dhikrs.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً).
