translation.en: (othman Ibn Al-AAas  narrated: I said ‘O Messenger of Allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ The Messenger of Allah  replied ‘That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) on your left side three times.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Whispering during prayer and recitation
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الوسوسة في الصلاة و القراءة

dhikrs.search: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم، واتفل علي يسارك (ثلاثا). (othman ibn al-aaas  narrated: i said ‘o messenger of allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ the messenger of allah  replied ‘that is a devil called khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in allah from him and spit (a form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) on your left side three times.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً.

translation.en: (O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa-anta taj'alul- hazana in shi'ta sahla.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — When something becomes difficult
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من استصعب عليه أمر

dhikrs.search: اللهم لا سهل الا ما جعلته سهلا، وانت تجعل الحزن اذا شيت سهلا. (allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa-anta taj'alul- hazana in shi'ta sahla.) (o allah, there is no ease except in that which you have made easy, and you make the difficulty, if you wish, easy.)

dhikrs.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ)

translation.en: (O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummaj-'alnee minat-tawwabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر بعد الفراغ من الوضوء

dhikrs.search: (اللهم اجعلني من التوابين واجعلني من المتطهرين) (allahummaj-'alnee minat-tawwabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen.) (o allah, make me of those who return to you often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.)

dhikrs.arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ.

translation.en: (Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer (i.e. two rakAAas) and then seeks Allah’s forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — After committing a sin
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يقول ويفعل من أذنب ذنبا

dhikrs.search: ما من عبد يذنب ذنبا فيحسن الطهور، ثم يقوم فيصلي ركعتين، ثم يستغفر الله الا غفر الله له. (any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer (i.e. two rakaaas) and then seeks allah’s forgiveness, allah would forgive him.)

dhikrs.arabic: الْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ.

translation.en: Seeking refuge from him.

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Against the devil's promptings
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء طرد الشيطان و وساوسه

dhikrs.search: الاستعاذه بالله منه. seeking refuge from him.

dhikrs.arabic: الْأَذَانُ.

translation.en: The Adhaan [call to prayer].

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Against the devil's promptings
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء طرد الشيطان و وساوسه

dhikrs.search: الاذان. the adhaan [call to prayer].

dhikrs.arabic: الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ.

translation.en: (Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.)(e.g. ‘Do not make your homes like the graveyards, indeed the devils flee from the house in which soorat Al-Baqarah has been read’ related by Muslim 1/539, also supplication and remembrance for the morning & evening, before sleep, when getting up, entering and leaving the toilet, entering and leaving the mosque, the recitation of ayat Al-kursiyy and the last two verses of soorat Al-Baqarah before sleeping, the athan…etc.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Against the devil's promptings
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء طرد الشيطان و وساوسه

dhikrs.search: الاذكار وقراءه القران. (recitation of the quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.)(e.g. ‘do not make your homes like the graveyards, indeed the devils flee from the house in which soorat al-baqarah has been read’ related by muslim 1/539, also supplication and remembrance for the morning & evening, before sleep, when getting up, entering and leaving the toilet, entering and leaving the mosque, the recitation of ayat al-kursiyy and the last two verses of soorat al-baqarah before sleeping, the athan…etc.)

dhikrs.arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ.

translation.en: (Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.)(for verily ‘If’ lets in the work of the devil.)

transliteration.en: (Qaddaral-lah, wama shaa fa'al.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — When something goes wrong
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء حينما يقع ما لا يرضاه أو ُ غلب على أمره

dhikrs.search: قدر الله وما شاء فعل. (qaddaral-lah, wama shaa fa'al.) (allah has decreed and what he wills, he does.)(for verily ‘if’ lets in the work of the devil.)

dhikrs.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ. وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَــــــنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ.

translation.en: May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly

transliteration.en: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu.  The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka.

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ﺗﻬنئة المولود له وجوابه

dhikrs.search: بارك الله لك في الموهوب لك، وشكرت الواهب، وبلغ اشده، ورزقت بره. ويرد عليه المهنا فيقول: بارك الله لك وبارك عليك، وجزاك الله خيرا، ورزقك الله مثله، واجزل ثوابك. baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu.  the reply of the person being congratulated is to say: baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka. may allah bless you with his gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. the reply of the person being congratulated is to say: may allah bless you, and shower his blessings upon you, and may allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly

dhikrs.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَينَ رضي الله عنهما أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ.

translation.en: (Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah  used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.

transliteration.en: (Ibn 'abbas related that the Messenger of Allah  used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(O'eethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli 'aynin lammah.))

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Seeking protection for children
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يعوذ به الأولاد

dhikrs.search: كان رسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم يعوذ الحسن والحسين رضي الله عنهما اعيذكما بكلمات الله التامه من كل شيطان وهامه، ومن كل عين لامه. (ibn 'abbas related that the messenger of allah  used to commend al-hasan and al-husayn to allah’s protection, saying:(o'eethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli 'aynin lammah.)) (ibn aaabbas related that the messenger of allah  used to commend al-hasan and al-husayn to allah’s protection, saying:(i commend you two to the protection of allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.

dhikrs.arabic: لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.

translation.en: (Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.)

transliteration.en: (La ba'sa tahoorun in shaal-lah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للمريض في عيادته

dhikrs.search: لا باس طهور ان شاء الله. (la ba'sa tahoorun in shaal-lah.) (never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if allah wills.)

dhikrs.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ (سبع مرات).

translation.en: (I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’.(7times) (he (the sick person) will be cured.

transliteration.en: (Asalul-lahal-'atheem rabbal-'arshil-'atheem an yashfeek (7times).)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للمريض في عيادته

dhikrs.search: اسال الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم ان يشفيك (سبع مرات). (asalul-lahal-'atheem rabbal-'arshil-'atheem an yashfeek (7times).) (i ask allah the supreme, lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’.(7times) (he (the sick person) will be cured.

dhikrs.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ.

translation.en: (Ali Ibn Abee Talib  related that he heard the Messenger of Allah  say: ‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — The reward for visiting the sick
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — فضل عيادة المريض

dhikrs.search: قال النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم: اذا عاد الرجل اخاه المسلم مشي في خرافه الجنه حتي يجلس، فاذا جلس غمرته الرحمه، فان كان غدوه صلي عليه سبعون الف ملك حتي يمسي، وان كان مساء صلي عليه سبعون الف ملك حتي يصبح. (ali ibn abee talib  related that he heard the messenger of allah  say: ‘if a man calls on his sick muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.)

dhikrs.arabic: (سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ).

translation.en: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.)

transliteration.en: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر بعد الفراغ من الوضوء

dhikrs.search: (سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك، اشهد ان لا اله الا انت، استغفرك واتوب اليك). (subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.) (how perfect you are o allah, and i praise you, i bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except you, i seek your forgiveness and turn in repentance to you.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى.

translation.en: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions

transliteration.en: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee wa-alhiqnee birrafeeqil-a'la.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone near the end
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته

dhikrs.search: اللهم اغفر لي، وارحمني، والحقني بالرفيق الاعلي. (allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee wa-alhiqnee birrafeeqil-a'la.) ‘o allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions

dhikrs.arabic: جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، وَيَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ.

translation.en: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’

transliteration.en: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say:[La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.] ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone near the end
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته

dhikrs.search: جعل النبي صلي الله عليه وسلم عند موته يدخل يديه في الماء فيمسح بهما وجهه، ويقول: لا اله الا الله ان للموت سكرات. 'aa.ishah (radhi-yallaahu 'anhaa) related that the prophet (sal-allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say:[la ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.] ‘none has the right to be worshipped except allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’ 'aa.ishah (radhi-yallaahu 'anhaa) related that the prophet (sal-allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say: ‘none has the right to be worshipped except allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’

dhikrs.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ.

translation.en: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.)

transliteration.en: (La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone near the end
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته

dhikrs.search: لا اله الا الله والله اكبر، لا اله الا الله وحده، لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له، لا اله الا الله له الملك وله الحمد، لا اله الا الله ولا حول ولا قوه الا بالله. (la ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.) (none has the right to be worshipped except allah and allah is the greatest.none has the right to be worshipped except allah, alone.none has the right to be worshipped except allah, alone, without partner.none has the right to be worshipped except allah, to him belongs all sovereignty and praise.  none has the right to be worshipped except allah and there is no might and no power except with allah.)

dhikrs.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.

translation.en: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.) will enter Paradise.)

transliteration.en: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (La ilaha illal-lah.) will enter Paradise.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — تلقين المحتضر

dhikrs.search: من كان اخر كلامه لا اله الا الله دخل الجنه. i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (he whose last words are: (la ilaha illal-lah.) will enter paradise.) i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (he whose last words are: (none has the right to be worshipped except allah.) will enter paradise.)

dhikrs.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا.

translation.en: (To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return.O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.)

transliteration.en: (Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi raji'oon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من أصيب بمصيبة

dhikrs.search: انا لله وانا اليه راجعون، اللهم اجرني في مصيبتي، واخلف لي خيرا منها. (inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi raji'oon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha.) (to allah we belong and unto him is our return.o allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلاَنٍ (بِاسْمِهِ) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ  يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ.

translation.en: (O Allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds.  Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die.  This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent (also refer to supplication #198).)

transliteration.en: (Allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfa' darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee 'aqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-'alameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Closing the eyes of the dead
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء عند إغماض الميت

dhikrs.search: اللهم اغفر لفلان (باسمه) وارفع درجته في المهديين، واخلفه في عقبه في الغابرين، واغفر لنا وله  يا رب العالمين، وافسح له في قبره، ونور له فيه. (allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfa' darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee 'aqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-'alameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh.) (o allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him o lord of the worlds.  make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.)(a successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. this is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of allah on earth because allah is never absent, and will never die.  this supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent (also refer to supplication #198).)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ].

translation.en: (O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth.  Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, wa'afihi, wa'fu 'anh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassi' mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-a'ithhu min 'athabil-qabr, wa'athabin-nar)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للميت في الصلاة عليه

dhikrs.search: اللهم اغفر له وارحمه، وعافه، واعف عنه، واكرم نزله، ووسع مدخله، واغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد، ونقه من الخطايا كما نقيت الثوب الابيض من الدنس، وابدله دارا خيرا من داره، واهلا خيرا من اهله، وزوجا خيرا من زوجه، وادخله الجنه، واعذه من عذاب القبر [وعذاب النار]. (allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, wa'afihi, wa'fu 'anh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassi' mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-a'ithhu min 'athabil-qabr, wa'athabin-nar) (o allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth.  exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. admit him into the garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the fire.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ.

translation.en: (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females.  O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith.  O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi 'alal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu 'alal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana ba'dah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للميت في الصلاة عليه

dhikrs.search: اللهم اغفر لحينا وميتنا، وشاهدنا وغايبنا، وصغيرنا وكبيرنا، وذكرنا وانثانا. اللهم من احييته منا فاحيه علي الاسلام، ومن توفيته منا فتوفه علي الايمان، اللهم لا تحرمنا اجره، ولا تضلنا بعده. (allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi 'alal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu 'alal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana ba'dah.) (o allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females.  o allah, whom amongst us you keep alive, then let such a life be upon islam, and whom amongst us you take unto yourself, then let such a death be upon faith.  o allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ.

translation.en: (O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire.  Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr wa'athabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للميت في الصلاة عليه

dhikrs.search: اللهم ان فلان بن فلان في ذمتك، وحبل جوارك، فقه من فتنه القبر، وعذاب النار، وانت اهل الوفاء والحق، فاغفر له وارحمه انك انت الغفور الرحيم. (allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr wa'athabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem.) (o allah, so-and-so is under your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the fire.  indeed you are faithful and truthful. forgive and have mercy upon him, surely you are the oft-forgiving, the most-merciful.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ.

translation.en: (O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma 'abduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun 'an 'athabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz 'anh.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للميت في الصلاة عليه

dhikrs.search: اللهم عبدك وابن امتك احتاج الي رحمتك، وانت غني عن عذابه، ان كان محسنا فزد في حسناته، وان كان مسييا فتجاوز عنه. (allahumma 'abduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun 'an 'athabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz 'anh.) (o allah, your servant and the son of your maidservant is in need of your mercy and you are without need of his punishment. if he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.)

dhikrs.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).

translation.en: (In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.)

transliteration.en: (Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu 'alal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر عند الخروج من المنزل

dhikrs.search: (بسم الله، توكلت علي الله، ولا حول ولا قوه الا بالله). (bismil-lah, tawakkaltu 'alal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.) (in the name of allah, i place my trust in allah, and there is no might nor power except with allah.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ وإن قال: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ إن قال ذلك فَحَسَنٌ.

translation.en: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave . [it is also good to say] O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good)  and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.

transliteration.en: (Allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) [or say:](Allahummaj-'alhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafee'an mujaban. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-a'thim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, waj'alhu fee kafalati Ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika 'athabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — The funeral prayer for a child
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للفرط في الصلاة عليه

dhikrs.search: اللهم اعذه من عذاب القبر وان قال: اللهم اجعله فرطا وذخرا لوالديه، وشفيعا مجابا، اللهم ثقل به موازينهما، واعظم به اجورهما، والحقه بصالح المومنين، واجعله في كفاله ابراهيم، وقه برحمتك عذاب الجحيم، وابدله دارا خيرا من داره، واهلا خيرا من اهله، اللهم اغفر لاسلافنا، وافراطنا، ومن سبقنا بالايمان ان قال ذلك فحسن. (allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) [or say:](allahummaj-'alhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafee'an mujaban. allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-a'thim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, waj'alhu fee kafalati ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika 'athabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan) o allah, protect him from the torment of the grave . [it is also good to say] o allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. o allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good)  and magnify their reward. make him join the righteous of the believers. place him in the care of ibrahim. save him by your mercy from the torment of hell. give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. o allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in faith.

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً.

translation.en: (O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward)

transliteration.en: (Allahummaj-'alhu lana farata, wasalafan wa-ajra.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — The funeral prayer for a child
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للفرط في الصلاة عليه

dhikrs.search: اللهم اجعله لنا فرطا، وسلفا، واجرا. (allahummaj-'alhu lana farata, wasalafan wa-ajra.) (o allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward)

dhikrs.arabic: إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ. وَإِنْ قَالَ: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ فَحَسَنٌ.

translation.en: (Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time…and then he  ordered for her to be patient and hope for Allah’s reward.)(The words (faltasbir waltahtasib) are commands in the feminine 3rd person form, so they will need to be changed in respect to whom is being addressed.)

transliteration.en: (Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma a'ta, wakullu shayin 'indahu bi-ajalin musamma…faltasbir waltahtasib.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء التعزية

dhikrs.search: ان لله ما اخذ، وله ما اعطي، وكل شيء عنده باجل مسمي... فلتصبر ولتحتسب. وان قال: اعظم الله اجرك، واحسن عزاءك، وغفر لميتك فحسن. (inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma a'ta, wakullu shayin 'indahu bi-ajalin musamma…faltasbir waltahtasib.) (verily to allah, belongs what he took and to him belongs what he gave, and everything with him has an appointed time…and then he  ordered for her to be patient and hope for allah’s reward.)(the words (faltasbir waltahtasib) are commands in the feminine 3rd person form, so they will need to be changed in respect to whom is being addressed.)

dhikrs.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ.

translation.en: (In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.)

transliteration.en: (Bismil-lahi wa'ala sunnati rasoolil-lah.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Placing the dead in the grave
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء عند إدخال الميت القبر

dhikrs.search: بسم الله وعلي سنه رسول الله. (bismil-lahi wa'ala sunnati rasoolil-lah.) (in the name of allah and upon the sunnah of the messenger of allah.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ.

translation.en: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him

transliteration.en: Allaahum-maghfir lahu Allaahumma thabbithu

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء بعد دفن الميت

dhikrs.search: اللهم اغفر له، اللهم ثبته. allaahum-maghfir lahu allaahumma thabbithu o allah, forgive him. o allah, strengthen him

dhikrs.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ.

translation.en: (Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you, we ask Allah for well-being for us and you.)

transliteration.en: (Assalamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-'afiyah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء زيارة القبور

dhikrs.search: السلام عليكم اهل الديار، من المومنين والمسلمين، وانا ان شاء الله بكم لاحقون، [ويرحم الله المستقدمين منا والمستاخرين] اسال الله لنا ولكم العافيه. (assalamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-'afiyah.) (peace be upon you all, o inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the muslims. verily we will, allah willing, be united with you, we ask allah for well-being for us and you.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْــــــأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا.

translation.en: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-a'oothu bika min sharriha.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — When the wind blows
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الريح

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني اسالك خيرها، واعوذ بك من شرها. (allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-a'oothu bika min sharriha.) (o allah, i ask you for it’s goodness and i take refuge with you from it’s evil.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ.

translation.en: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-a'oothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — When the wind blows
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الريح

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني اسالك خيرها، وخير ما فيها، وخير ما ارسلت به، واعوذ بك من شرها، وشر ما فيها، وشر ما ارسلت به. (allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-a'oothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih.) (o allah, i ask you for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and i take refuge with you from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.)

dhikrs.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ.

translation.en: (How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.)

transliteration.en: (Subhanal-lathee yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdih, walmala-ikatu min kheefatih.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الرعد

dhikrs.search: سبحان الذي يسبح الرعد بحمده والملايكه من خيفته. (subhanal-lathee yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdih, walmala-ikatu min kheefatih.) (how perfect he is, (the one) whom the thunder declares his perfection with his praise, as do the angles out of fear of him.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ.

translation.en: (O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an muree'an, nafi'an, ghayra dar, 'ajilan ghayra ajil.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — من أدعية الاستسقاء

dhikrs.search: اللهم اسقنا غيثا مغيثا مرييا مريعا، نافعا غير ضار، عاجلا غير اجل. (allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an muree'an, nafi'an, ghayra dar, 'ajilan ghayra ajil.) (o allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.)

dhikrs.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ).

translation.en: (O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.)(slip: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma innee a'oothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alay.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر عند الخروج من المنزل

dhikrs.search: (اللهم اني اعوذ بك ان اضل، او اضل، او ازل، او ازل، او اظلم، او اظلم، او اجهل، او يجهل علي). (allahumma innee a'oothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alay.) (o allah, i take refuge with you lest i should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.)(slip: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا.

translation.en: (O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — من أدعية الاستسقاء

dhikrs.search: اللهم اغثنا، اللهم اغثنا، اللهم اغثنا. (allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna.) (o allah, relieve us, o allah, relieve us, o allah, relieve us.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ.

translation.en: (O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.)

transliteration.en: (Allahummas-qi 'ibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — من أدعية الاستسقاء

dhikrs.search: اللهم اسق عبادك، وبهايمك، وانشر رحمتك، واحيي بلدك الميت. (allahummas-qi 'ibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit.) (o allah, provide water for your servants and your cattle, spread out your mercy and resurrect your dead land.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً.

translation.en: (O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء إذا نزل المطر

dhikrs.search: اللهم صيبا نافعا. (allahumma sayyiban nafi'a.) (o allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.)

dhikrs.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ.

translation.en: (We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.)

transliteration.en: (Mutirna bifadlil-lahi warahmatih.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر بعد نزول المطر

dhikrs.search: مطرنا بفضل الله ورحمته. (mutirna bifadlil-lahi warahmatih.) (we have been given rain by the grace and mercy of allah.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ.

translation.en: (O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma hawalayna wala 'alayna, allahumma 'alal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — When the rain will not stop
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — من أدعية الاستصحاء

dhikrs.search: اللهم حوالينا ولا علينا، اللهم علي الاكام والظراب، وبطون الاوديه، ومنابت الشجر. (allahumma hawalayna wala 'alayna, allahumma 'alal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar.) (o allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, o allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ.

translation.en: (Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.)

transliteration.en: (Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Sighting the new moon
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء رؤية الهلال

dhikrs.search: الله اكبر، اللهم اهله علينا بالامن والايمان، والسلامه والاسلام، والتوفيق لما تحب ربنا وترضي، ربنا وربك الله. (allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah.) (allah is the greatest. o allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and islam, and in agreement with all that you love and pleases you. our lord and your lord is allah.)

dhikrs.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.

translation.en: (The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.)

transliteration.en: (Thahabath-thama-o wabtallatil-'urooq, wathabatal-ajru in shaal-lah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء عند إفطار الصائم

dhikrs.search: ذهب الظما وابتلت العروق، وثبت الاجر ان شاء الله. (thahabath-thama-o wabtallatil-'urooq, wathabatal-ajru in shaal-lah.) (the thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if allah wills.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي.

translation.en: (O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasi'at kulla shay, an taghfira lee.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء عند إفطار الصائم

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني اسالك برحمتك التي وسعت كل شيء ان تغفر لي. (allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasi'at kulla shay, an taghfira lee.) (o allah, i ask you by your mercy which envelopes all things, that you forgive me.)

dhikrs.arabic: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ.

translation.en: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):In the name of Allah in it’s beginning and end.)

transliteration.en: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء قبل الطعام

dhikrs.search: اذا اكل احدكم طعاما فليقل بسم الله، فان نسي في اوله فليقل بسم الله في اوله واخره. (when you are about to eat, you should say:(bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.) (when you are about to eat, you should say:(bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):in the name of allah in it’s beginning and end.)

dhikrs.arabic: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ.

translation.en: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(O Allah, bless it for usand give us more of it.

transliteration.en: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-at'imna khayran minh.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.))

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء قبل الطعام

dhikrs.search: من اطعمه الله الطعام فليقل: اللهم بارك لنا فيه واطعمنا خيرا منه، ومن سقاه الله لبنا فليقل اللهم بارك لنا فيه وزدنا منه. (whomever allah feeds, should say:(allahumma barik lana feehi wa-at'imna khayran minh.) and whomever allah gives milk to drink should say:(allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.)) (whomever allah feeds, should say:(o allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.) and whomever allah gives milk to drink should say:(o allah, bless it for usand give us more of it.

dhikrs.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ).

translation.en: (In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.)

transliteration.en: (Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, wa'ala rabbina tawakkalna.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الذكر عند دخول المنزل

dhikrs.search: (بسم الله ولجنا، وبسم الله خرجنا، وعلي الله ربنا توكلنا، ثم ليسلم علي اهله). (bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, wa'ala rabbina tawakkalna.) (in the name of allah we enter and in the name of allah we leave, and upon our lord we place our trust.)

dhikrs.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ.

translation.en: (All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.)

transliteration.en: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee at'amanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء عند الفراغ من الطعام

dhikrs.search: الحمد لله الذي اطعمني هذا، ورزقنيه، من غير حول مني ولا قوه. (alhamdu lillahil-lathee at'amanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.) (all praise is for allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.)

dhikrs.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا.

translation.en: (Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.)(There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.)

transliteration.en: (Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwadda'in, wala mustaghnan 'anhu rabbuna.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء عند الفراغ من الطعام

dhikrs.search: الحمد لله حمدا كثيرا طيبا مباركا فيه، غير [مكفي ولا ] مودع، ولا مستغني عنه ربنا. (alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwadda'in, wala mustaghnan 'anhu rabbuna.) (allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, he is our lord.)(there are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. he is the one who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. the one who is longed for, along with that which is with him and the one who is needed, he is our lord.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ.

translation.en: (O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — A guest's du'a for the host
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الضيف لصاحب الطعام

dhikrs.search: اللهم بارك لهم فيما رزقتهم، واغفر لهم وارحمهم. (allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.) (o allah, bless for them, that which you have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي.

translation.en: (O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma at'im man at'amanee wasqi man saqanee.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone who gives you a drink
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — التعريض بالدعاء لطلب الطعام أو الشراب

dhikrs.search: اللهم اطعم من اطعمني، واسق من سقاني. (allahumma at'im man at'amanee wasqi man saqanee.) (o allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.)

dhikrs.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ.

translation.en: (May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.)

transliteration.en: (Aftara 'indakumus-sa-imoon, wa-akala ta'amakumul-abrar, wasallat 'alaykumul-mala-ikah.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For a family who feeds you at iftar
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت

dhikrs.search: افطر عندكم الصايمون، واكل طعامكم الابرار، وصلت عليكم الملايكه. (aftara 'indakumus-sa-imoon, wa-akala ta'amakumul-abrar, wasallat 'alaykumul-mala-ikah.) (may the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.)

dhikrs.arabic: إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ ، وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.

translation.en: (If you are not invited (to a meal) then answer.  If  you happen to be fasting, then supplicate (for those present) and if you are not fasting, then eat.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Declining food while fasting
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الصائم إذا حضر الطعام ولم يفطر

dhikrs.search: اذا دعي احدكم فليجب، فان كان صايما فليصل، وان كان مفطرا فليطعم ، ومعني فليصل اي فليدع. (if you are not invited (to a meal) then answer.  if  you happen to be fasting, then supplicate (for those present) and if you are not fasting, then eat.)

dhikrs.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ.

translation.en: (I am fasting, I am fasting.)

transliteration.en: (Innee sa-im, innee sa-im.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — When someone is rude while you fast
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يقول الصائم إذا سابه أحد

dhikrs.search: اني صايم، اني صايم. (innee sa-im, innee sa-im.) (i am fasting, i am fasting.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا.

translation.en: (O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saAA for us and bless our mudd for us.)(A saAA is equivalent to four mudds and a mudd is equivalent to a dry measure of an average man’s two palms.)

transliteration.en: (Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina, wabarik lana fee sa'ina wabarik lana fee muddina.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — The first dates of the season
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء عند رؤية باكورة الثمر

dhikrs.search: اللهم بارك لنا في ثمرنا، وبارك لنا في مدينتنا، وبارك لنا في صاعنا، وبارك لنا في مدنا. (allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina, wabarik lana fee sa'ina wabarik lana fee muddina.) (o allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saaa for us and bless our mudd for us.)(a saaa is equivalent to four mudds and a mudd is equivalent to a dry measure of an average man’s two palms.)

dhikrs.arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.

translation.en: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise if for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

transliteration.en: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(Alhamdu lillah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (Yarhamukal-lah.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.))

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء العطاس

dhikrs.search: اذا عطس احدكم فليقل الحمد لله، وليقل له اخوه او صاحبه: يرحمك الله، فاذا قال له: يرحمك الله، فليقل: يهديكم الله ويصلح بالكم. (when one of you sneezes he should say:(alhamdu lillah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (yarhamukal-lah.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.)) (when one of you sneezes he should say:(all praise if for allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (may allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(may allah guide you and rectify your condition.

dhikrs.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.

translation.en: (May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.)

transliteration.en: (Yahdeekum wayuslihu balakum.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — When a non-Muslim praises Allah after sneezing
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يقال للكافر إذا عطس فحمد الله

dhikrs.search: يهديكم الله ويصلح بالكم. (yahdeekum wayuslihu balakum.) (may allah guide you and rectify your condition.)

dhikrs.arabic: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُوراً، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُوراً، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُوراً، وَعَظِّم لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُوراً، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُوراً، وَفِي دَمِي نُوراً، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُوراً)([اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قَبْرِي... وَنُوراً فِي عِظَامِي])[(وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً)][(وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً عَلَى نُورٍ)]

translation.en: (‘O Allaah, place within my heart light; and upon my tongue light; and within my ears light; and within my eyes light; and place above me light; and beneath me light; and on my right light; and on my left light; and in front of me light; and behind me light; and place light within my soul; and augment light for me; and greaten light for me; and grant me light and make me light. O Allaah, bestow upon me light; and place light in my tendons; and light in my flesh; and light in my blood; and in light in my hair and light in my skin.’ [O Allaah, place light for me in my grave and light in my bones]. [And increase me with light and increase me with light and increase me with light]. [And grant me light upon light.]’)

transliteration.en: Allaahummaj 'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran. Wa j'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran. Waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran. Allaahumma a'tineje nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wa fee lahmee nooran, wa fee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.[Allaahummaj'al lee nooran fee qabree, wa nooran fee 'idhaamee.][Wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran.][Wa hab lee nooran 'alaa noor.]

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Setting out for the mosque
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الذهاب إلى المسجد

dhikrs.search: (اللهم اجعل في قلبي نورا، وفي لساني نورا، وفي سمعي نورا، وفي بصري نورا، ومن فوقي نورا، ومن تحتي نورا، وعن يميني نورا، وعن شمالي نورا، ومن امامي نورا، ومن خلفي نورا، واجعل في نفسي نورا، واعظم لي نورا، وعظم لي نورا، واجعل لي نورا، واجعلني نورا، اللهم اعطني نورا، واجعل في عصبي نورا، وفي لحمي نورا، وفي دمي نورا، وفي شعري نورا، وفي بشري نورا)([اللهم اجعل لي نورا في قبري... ونورا في عظامي])[(وزدني نورا، وزدني نورا، وزدني نورا)][(وهب لي نورا علي نور)] allaahummaj 'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran. wa j'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran. waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran. allaahumma a'tineje nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wa fee lahmee nooran, wa fee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.[allaahummaj'al lee nooran fee qabree, wa nooran fee 'idhaamee.][wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran.][wa hab lee nooran 'alaa noor.] (‘o allaah, place within my heart light; and upon my tongue light; and within my ears light; and within my eyes light; and place above me light; and beneath me light; and on my right light; and on my left light; and in front of me light; and behind me light; and place light within my soul; and augment light for me; and greaten light for me; and grant me light and make me light. o allaah, bestow upon me light; and place light in my tendons; and light in my flesh; and light in my blood; and in light in my hair and light in my skin.’ [o allaah, place light for me in my grave and light in my bones]. [and increase me with light and increase me with light and increase me with light]. [and grant me light upon light.]’)

dhikrs.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ.

translation.en: (May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.)

transliteration.en: (Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka 'alayk, wajama'a baynakuma fee khayr.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء للمتزوج

dhikrs.search: بارك الله لك، وبارك عليك، وجمع بينكما في خير. (barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka 'alayk, wajama'a baynakuma fee khayr.) (may allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may he unite both of you in goodness.)

dhikrs.arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.

translation.en: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:(O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)

transliteration.en: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha 'alayh, wa-a'oothu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha 'alayh.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — On the wedding night
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء المتزوج و شراء الدابة

dhikrs.search: اذا تزوج احدكم امراه، او اذا اشتري خادما فليقل: اللهم اني اسالك خيرها، وخير ما جبلتها عليه، واعوذ بك من شرها، وشر ما جبلتها عليه، واذا اشتري بعيرا فلياخذ بذروه سنامه وليقل مثل ذلك. (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say: (allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha 'alayh, wa-a'oothu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha 'alayh.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.) (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:(o allah, i ask you for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and i take refuge with you from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)

dhikrs.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا.

translation.en: (In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.)

transliteration.en: (Bismil-lah, allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wajannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء قبل إتيان الزوجة

dhikrs.search: بسم الله، اللهم جنبنا الشيطان، وجنب الشيطان ما رزقتنا. (bismil-lah, allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wajannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.) (in the name of allah. o allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.)

dhikrs.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.

translation.en: (I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.)

transliteration.en: (a'oothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الغضب

dhikrs.search: اعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم. (a'oothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.) (i take refuge with allah from the accursed devil.)

dhikrs.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً.

translation.en: (All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.)

transliteration.en: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee 'afanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee 'ala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء من رأى مبتلى

dhikrs.search: الحمد لله الذي عافاني مما ابتلاك به، وفضلني علي كثير ممن خلق تفضيلا. (alhamdu lillahil-lathee 'afanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee 'ala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela.) (all praise is for allah who saved me from that which he tested you with and who most certainly favoured me over much of his creation.)

dhikrs.arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ.

translation.en: (Ibn AAumar  said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.

transliteration.en: (Ibn 'umar  said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (Rabbigh-fir lee watub 'alay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.))

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Sitting in a gathering
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يقال في اﻟﻤﺠلس

dhikrs.search: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه قال: كان يعد لرسول الله صلي الله عليه وسلم في المجلس الواحد مايه مره من قبل ان يقوم: رب اغفر لي، وتب علي، انك انت التواب الغفور. (ibn 'umar  said: it would be counted that the messenger of allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (rabbigh-fir lee watub 'alay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.)) (ibn aaumar  said: it would be counted that the messenger of allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (o my lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). verily you are the oft-returning. the oft-forgiving.

dhikrs.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.

translation.en: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You.  I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You.  I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.)

transliteration.en: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — كفارة اﻟﻤﺠلس

dhikrs.search: سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك، اشهد ان لا اله الا انت، استغفرك واتوب اليك. (subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.) (how perfect you are o allah, and i praise you.  i bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except you.  i seek your forgiveness and turn to you in repentance.)

dhikrs.arabic: وَلَكَ.

translation.en: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis  said: ‘I went to see the Prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him: (May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah.) he  replied: (and you.

transliteration.en: ('abdullah Ibn Sarjis  said: ‘I went to see the Prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him:(Ghafaral-lahu laka ya rasoolal-lah.) he  replied: (wa-lak))

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone who says 'may Allah forgive you'
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء لمن قال غفر الله لك

dhikrs.search: ولك. ('abdullah ibn sarjis  said: ‘i went to see the prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him:(ghafaral-lahu laka ya rasoolal-lah.) he  replied: (wa-lak)) (aaabdullah ibn sarjis  said: ‘i went to see the prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him: (may allah forgive you, o messenger of allah.) he  replied: (and you.

dhikrs.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً.

translation.en: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (May Allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)

transliteration.en: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (Jazakal-lahu khayran.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone who does you good
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء لمن صنع إليك معروفا

dhikrs.search: جزاك الله خيرا. (if someone does you a favour and you say: (jazakal-lahu khayran.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.) (if someone does you a favour and you say: (may allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)

dhikrs.arabic: مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.

translation.en: (Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about.  Most of mankind will folow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when Muslims will conquer Constantinople.  He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophet-hood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection.  The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)(Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.)(One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.(Refer to supplications #55 & #56

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — Protection from the Dajjal
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — ما يعصم الله به من الدجال

dhikrs.search: من حفظ عشر ايات من اول سوره الكهف عصم من الدجال ، والاستعاذه بالله من فتنته عقب التشهد الاخير من كل صلاه. (dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every prophet has warned about.  most of mankind will folow him. he will appear from asbahan, iran at the time when muslims will conquer constantinople.  he will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. he will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophet-hood and finally, divinity. from his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be allah as it is a sign of imperfection.  the word kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)(whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat al-kahf will be protected from dajjal.)(one should also seek refuge with allah from the tribulations of the dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.(refer to supplications #55 & #56

dhikrs.arabic: ( لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي ).

translation.en: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable.  How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.O my Lord forgive me)

transliteration.en: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'ala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala  ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil 'atheem. Rabbigh-fir lee)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — أذكار الاستيقاظ من النوم

dhikrs.search: ( لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهو علي كل شيء قدير، سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا اله الا الله، والله اكبر، ولا حول ولا قوه الا بالله العلي العظيم، رب اغفر لي ). (la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'ala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala  ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil 'atheem. rabbigh-fir lee) (none has the right to be worshipped except allah, alone without associate, to him belongs sovereignty and praise and he is over all things wholly capable.  how perfect allah is, and all praise is for allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except allah, allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with allah, the most high, the supreme.o my lord forgive me)

dhikrs.arabic: (يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى) ، وَيَقُولُ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ  [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ]  اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.

translation.en: (I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah.  O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.)

transliteration.en: (a'oothu billahil-'atheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, [bismil-lah, wassalatu] [wassalamu 'ala rasoolil-lah] , allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء دخول المسجد

dhikrs.search: (يبدا برجله اليمني) ، ويقول: اعوذ بالله العظيم، وبوجهه الكريم، وسلطانه القديم، من الشيطان الرجيم  [بسم الله، والصلاه] [والسلام علي رسول الله]  اللهم افتح لي ابواب رحمتك. (a'oothu billahil-'atheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, [bismil-lah, wassalatu] [wassalamu 'ala rasoolil-lah] , allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik.) (i take refuge with allah, the supreme and with his noble face, and his eternal authority from the accursed devil. in the name of allah, and prayers and peace be upon the messenger of allah.  o allah, open the gates of your mercy for me.)

dhikrs.arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ.

translation.en: (May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.)

transliteration.en: (Ahabbakal-lathee ahbabtanee lah.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone who loves you for Allah's sake
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء لمن قال إني أحبك في الله

dhikrs.search: احبك الذي احببتني له. (ahabbakal-lathee ahbabtanee lah.) (may he, for whom you have loved me, love you.)

dhikrs.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ.

translation.en: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.)

transliteration.en: (Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone who shares their wealth
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء لمن عرض عليك ماله

dhikrs.search: بارك الله لك في اهلك ومالك. (barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik.) (may allah bless for you, your family and wealth.)

dhikrs.arabic: بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ.

translation.en: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.)

transliteration.en: (Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — On repaying a loan
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء لمن أقرض عند القضاء

dhikrs.search: بارك الله لك في اهلك ومالك، انما جزاء السلف الحمد والاداء. (barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.) (may allah bless for you, your family and wealth. surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ.

translation.en: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.)

transliteration.en: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(Allahumma innee a'oothu bika an oshrika bika wa-ana a'lam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la a'lam.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء الخوف من الشرك

dhikrs.search: اللهم اني اعوذ بك ان اشرك بك وانا اعلم، واستغفرك لما لا اعلم. (shirk: to associate others with allah in those things which are specific to him.  this can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than allah.)(allahumma innee a'oothu bika an oshrika bika wa-ana a'lam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la a'lam.) (shirk: to associate others with allah in those things which are specific to him.  this can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than allah.)(o allah, i take refuge in you lest i should commit shirk with you knowingly and i seek your forgiveness for what i do unknowingly.)

dhikrs.arabic: وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ.

translation.en: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah  was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution.  When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (May Allah bless you all.) AAaishah would then say: (and may Allah bless them.(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)

transliteration.en: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah  was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution.  When the servant would come back (from distributing it), 'aishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (Barakal-lahu feekum.) 'aishah would then say: (Wafeehim barakal-lah.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)

reference.en: Hisn al-Muslim — For someone who says 'may Allah bless you'
reference.ar: حصن المسلم — الدعاء لمن قال بارك الله فيك

dhikrs.search: وفيك بارك الله. (aaishah reported that the messenger of allah  was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution.  when the servant would come back (from distributing it), 'aishah would ask: ‘what did they say?’, he replied: they would supplicate: (barakal-lahu feekum.) 'aishah would then say: (wafeehim barakal-lah.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.) (aaishah reported that the messenger of allah  was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution.  when the servant would come back (from distributing it), aaaishah would ask: ‘what did they say?’, he replied: they would supplicate: (may allah bless you all.) aaaishah would then say: (and may allah bless them.(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)

dhikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.

translation.en: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)

transliteration.en: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.)

reference.ar: حصن المسلم — دعاء كراهية الطيرة

dhikrs.search: اللهم لا طير الا طيرك، ولا خير الا خيرك، ولا اله غيرك. (this supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.) (this supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(o allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on you, there is no good except your good and none has the right to be worshipped except you.)
